reasons: Cited text supports the compliant classification: Section 13.1 expressly extends the subscription grant to Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf, satisfying the preferred position on affiliate/contractor scope without any notice condition.

Section 13.2 provides a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence for paid-up or embedded Vendor Technology, and Section 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor under the Section 24 assignment right, matching the preferred transferability and perpetuity terms.

Section 13.3 bars revocation or suspension except for a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a reasonable cure period, so the licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion (no walk-away trigger); deterministic checks for affiliate coverage and absence of at-will revocation both pass.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed, and none is warranted — raising an edit here would be over-flagging a clause that already meets the preferred position.
